sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B model card
sources.evidence: Post-trained vision-language checkpoint. The language-model section labels 4B parameters; documents native 262,144 context, text/image/video input, text generation, thinking control, and tool calling.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration with dense FFNs, 32 language layers in a 3:1 linear/full attention pattern, a vision encoder, one MTP layer, and max_position_embeddings 262144; no routed-expert configuration.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B repository safetensors metadata
sources.evidence: safetensors.total is 4,659,865,088: 4,659,861,248 BF16 and 3,840 F32 stored parameters. Repository creation was February 27, which is not evidence of public release.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release news
sources.evidence: QwenLM/Qwen3.5 redirects to this renamed official repository. Retained news explicitly announces Qwen3.5-4B availability on Hugging Face and ModelScope on 2026-03-02; repository identifies Qwen team as part of Alibaba Group.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B LICENSE
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint repository supplies Apache License 2.0.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Published weight map contains model.language_model, model.visual, and mtp tensors; the full checkpoint count therefore includes the vision encoder and auxiliary multi-token-prediction weights.

name.note: Catalog spacing denotes the official Qwen3.5-4B checkpoint.

family.note: Qwen3.5 belongs to the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Explicit public weight-release announcement; neither repository creation nor hosted API availability.

parameters_b.note: Full published checkpoint total divided by 1e9; includes language, vision, and MTP tensors. The card’s 4B is the nominal language-component count.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active count is documented. Dense FFNs do not justify equating the full multimodal/MTP checkpoint with parameters active per token.

architecture.note: Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated attention and a vision encoder. Generic family-card MoE wording does not describe this variant.

context_window.note: Native context; optional YaRN extension reaches 1,010,000.

modalities.note: Exact-model examples cover all three inputs and text responses.

reasoning.note: Thinking is enabled by default and can be disabled.

tool_call.note: Exact-model vLLM/SGLang tool-call commands and Qwen-Agent example.

description.value: Post-trained dense vision-language model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention, switchable thinking, and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces the unquantified low-cost claim with documented capabilities.

patch.description: Post-trained dense vision-language model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention, switchable thinking, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Full checkpoint: 4,659,865,088 stored parameters, including vision and auxiliary MTP weights. The 4B label describes the nominal language model. Active parameters are not separately reported. Native context is 262,144; optional YaRN extension is 1,010,000. Release date denotes public weights.

summary: Corrects the full checkpoint total from nominal 4B to 4.659865088B and confirms dense hybrid-attention architecture. Active count stays undisclosed. Confirms the March 2 public weight release, Apache-2.0, modalities, native context, thinking, and tool calling; removes unsupported low-cost wording. Optional language-model component is nominal, as explicitly labeled in the card.
